name: 共有方法を確認する招待コード画面
prompt:
Recreate the full Japanese invite-code screen to exactly match the native preview at 390 × 704 px. Use the native preview for all Japanese wording, layout, colors and scale. Use the source screenshot only for context, and preserve the exact attached QR sample image rather than inventing a new code. Flat white mobile screen with no device frame.

Header: centered 「招待コード」 at x=24,y=10,w=342,h=28, Meiryo Bold 20 px #1D1D1D. Keep the small green outlined share icon at x=353,y=17,w=19,h=18.

Invitation card: white, thin #E8ECE9 border, x=30,y=148,w=330,h=338, 12 px corners. Center the 50×50 mint circle with 「光」 at x=170,y=120, using Meiryo Bold 14 px #064E3B. Center 「地域のなかま」 at x=46,y=190,w=298,h=28 in Meiryo Bold 20 px #1D1D1D; center 「グループの招待コード・見本」 at x=46,y=226,w=298,h=16 in Meiryo Regular 12 px #6E6E6E. Place the exact black-and-white QR image with central WhatsApp mark at x=108,y=270,w=174,h=174. Preserve its exact pattern; it is a sample, not an operational invite.

Below the card, keep this exact three-line privacy copy centered at x=30,y=528,w=330,h=48, Meiryo Regular 12 px #6E6E6E:
このコードを共有すると、受け取った人が
グループに参加できます。招待したい相手に
だけ共有してください。

At x=30,y=598,w=330,h=16, center 「コードの共有について」 in Meiryo Bold 12 px blue #1976D2. This is the actual learn-more hyperlink. Only this text is blue. At x=30,y=642,w=330,h=24, center 「招待コードをリセット」 in Meiryo Regular 14 px #047857; this remains the separate reset operation.

Do not copy English text, the source portrait, or other brand elements. Do not alter the QR, add a URL or add extra controls. Keep the body gray, reset action green, header dark and share icon green.
reviewNotes: Blue hyperlink コードの共有について is correct; reset remains green. QR is exact native crop but a thin horizontal artifact remains above it. Card/avatar/title cluster is about 7-10px high and privacy body about 15% too large; correct in v002.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
